mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message ( message_id, thread_id, role, content, status, invocation_id, task_id, agent_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{messageId}, #{threadId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{status}, #{invocationId}, #{taskId}, #{agentId}, #{createdAt, typeHandler=com.agentcrossing.platform.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{updatedAt, typeHandler=com.agentcrossing.platform.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE thread_id = VALUES(thread_id), role = VALUES(role), content = VALUES(content), status = VALUES(status), invocation_id = VALUES(invocation_id), task_id = VALUES(task_id), agent_id = VALUES(agent_id), created_at = VALUES(created_at), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT message.* FROM ( SELECT message.message_id, message.created_at FROM chat_message message JOIN chat_thread thread ON thread.thread_id = message.thread_id AND thread.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN agent_context_message_receipt receipt ON receipt.user_id = #{userId} AND receipt.thread_id = message.thread_id AND receipt.agent_id = #{currentAgentId} AND receipt.message_id = message.message_id WHERE message.thread_id = #{threadId} AND message.status = 'COMPLETED' AND ( message.role = 'USER' OR (message.role = 'ASSISTANT' AND message.agent_id IS NOT NULL AND message.agent_id != #{currentAgentId}) ) AND (receipt.message_id IS NULL OR receipt.content_version != message.context_version) ORDER BY message.created_at DESC, message.message_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) recent_messages JOIN chat_message message ON message.message_id = recent_messages.message_id ORDER BY recent_messages.created_at ASC, recent_messages.message_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_context_message_receipt SET summarized_version = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND thread_id = #{threadId} AND agent_id = #{agentId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chat_message WHERE invocation_id = #{invocationId} AND role = 'ASSISTANT' ORDER BY created_at ASC, message_id ASC LIMIT 1
